title: fix(theme): restore red brand tokens
body:
## Summary

- Restore Red's CSS theme tokens on current `main` after the recent identity/template sync left the public accent and primary colors on the template blue hue.
- Updates light and dark `--primary`, `--ring`, `--accent-*`, `--sidebar-primary`, and `--sidebar-ring` values to the red brand hue.

## What changed on main

Current `origin/main` includes PR #16 (`feat(identity): set repo-spec intent — hook + mission + brand{icon,color}`), which correctly set `.cogni/repo-spec.yaml` to `brand.color: "#ef4444"`, but `app/src/styles/tailwind.css` still had blue `217` tokens. That is why the live page showed a red icon but blue `/red`, headline gradient, CTA button, and spinner/accent controls.

## Verification

- Fetched current `origin/main` before patching.
- Static token check passed for light/dark primary, ring, and accent variables.

## Note

Local `typecheck` and dev rendering are currently blocked on unrelated `origin/main` package/export issues in `repoSpec.server.ts` / `@cogni/repo-spec`, before this CSS change is involved.

title: feat(ctf): add evidence-led workflow and Fullpwn field guides
body:
## Summary

- add a repo-local `solve-ctf-challenges` skill for evidence-led, authorized CTF work
- require explicit win predicates, live progress records, controlled experiments, and independent flag verification
- add a private-lab routing playbook covering event-specific profiles, target-route proof, outer VPN routes, and competing-VPN conflicts
- add a concise macOS HTB CTF Fullpwn VPN setup guide backed by official HTB and OpenVPN references
- add a sanitized Windows Fullpwn case study from SQL injection through MSSQL command execution and SYSTEM token impersonation
- keep live targets, VPN material, credentials, literal flags, and proof hashes in gitignored `.context` records

## Lessons preserved

- a connected VPN UI is not proof that the target subnet uses the right route
- a commercial VPN can silently nest and destabilize the HTB tunnel
- a local or bundled flag is not a live win, and one flag is not a two-flag win
- database sysadmin is a capability boundary; inspect the OS service token before selecting privilege escalation
- change implementations after a proven primitive fails instead of discarding the evidence-backed hypothesis
- clean up staged tools and restore modified service configuration

## Validation

- skill validator: `quick_validate.py .claude/skills/solve-ctf-challenges`
- `git diff --check`
- public-diff scan for target IPs, literal flags, profile identifiers, certificates, and private keys
- repo-wide checks intentionally left to CI at the user request because the local device is resource constrained
